Traversal is capped at eight total visited nodes; scale materialization is bounded. No approximation is performed by the extractor.
change.binary_offset_boundary: Nested binary offsets combine only when checked exponent addition fits i32. Otherwise both exact offset nodes remain; both exponent extremes and affine round trips are tested without approximation.

polynomial_evaluation_retains_reconstructed_quadratic_midpoints: both roots, two rational widths, four midpoint forms, three coefficient scales, and signed 2^-600 perturbations.
test_changes: Opaque sine/log midpoint cancellation is checked in both subtraction orders and as a negated sum at precision floor zero.
